floor.label: Floor
floor.blurb: Clear ground. Costs one square to cross.

wall.label: Wall
wall.blurb: Blocks movement and line of sight.

water.label: Water
water.blurb: Liquid. Wade, swim, or keep out.

hazard.label: Hazard
hazard.blurb: Difficult, and it hurts to stand in.

lowwall.label: Low wall
lowwall.blurb: Half cover. Blocks movement, not sight.

door.label: Door
door.blurb: A portal that can open, close and lock.
